node.title: XR rank-two zero baselines have divisor arity and collision-design normal form
node.statement: For a rank-two relation occupying a full minimal Maxwell core at an official odd reserve, exact baseline D_0=0 forces t=2s+2 with s dividing h and even D=d+1. Every defect charge vanishes, the outside extensions form an exact multiplicity-one/two collision design, all five-row cores are impossible, and four-row cores have D=2h with no inactive extensions. Exact divisor, degree-capacity, private-congruence, and a<=k arithmetic gives necessary affine-rank floors 10,10,6,8601474050,8601474050,4302648690 on the six rows. Strictly negative baselines, proper circuits, higher trade rank, nonuniform cells, and aggregate payment remain open.
